rules.entry: limit BUY at S1, next session only; skip if the session opens at or below S1
rules.stock_filter: T-1 close > 200d MA and 200d MA rising over 20 sessions
rules.sizing: 1% equity risk per trade, capped at 10% notional per name

performance_source: 第三方 10 年回測（2016–2026，2023–26 樣本外），規則見 Leeks Terminal 10 年訊號審計報告
